lines: In fire and tarpaṇa, by abundance especially dakṣiṇā of guru, poor-and
l4.sanskrit_cite: agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bhūriviśeṣāddakṣiṇā guroḥ dīnāditṛptirvibhavādyāga ityadhiko vidhiḥ
